# Rehan Quant Lab (RQL)
> Sovereign Pure-Rust Desktop Computing. Air-Gapped Execution, Zero Cloud Telemetry, Lifetime Perpetual Ownership.

Rehan Quant Lab (founded by Mohammad Rehan, Systems Architect in Patna, Bihar, India) engineers high-performance, single-binary Windows desktop software for commercial enterprises, retail operators, legal chambers, chartered accountants, and quantitative institutions. Every application runs 100% offline with zero cloud dependencies, zero telemetry, and zero recurring monthly SaaS fees.

- [Commercial Store](https://rehanquantlab.com/store.html): The complete catalog of 31 Commercial Desktop Workstations with direct Gumroad perpetual license acquisition.
- [Systems Portfolio](https://rehanquantlab.com/projects.html): Production software architecture, performance metrics, and quantitative research.
- [Security Architecture](https://rehanquantlab.com/security.html): Air-gapped compliance, SHA-256 binary provenance, HIPAA/GDPR/DPDP compliance documentation.

## Free Interactive In-Browser Tool Suite (Zero-Upload Client-Side WebCrypto)
- [Offline PDF Redactor](https://rehanquantlab.com/tools/offline-pdf-redactor.html): In-browser zero-upload PDF vector redactor and metadata stripper.
- [SHA-256 Checksum Verifier](https://rehanquantlab.com/tools/sha256-checksum-verifier.html): Cryptographic binary verifier running in local browser RAM using WebCrypto API.
- [Offline QR Code Generator](https://rehanquantlab.com/tools/offline-qr-code-generator.html): Vector SVG/PNG barcode and QR generator with zero server transmission.
- [Offline Text Diff](https://rehanquantlab.com/tools/offline-text-diff.html): Sub-millisecond text and code token difference analyzer.
- [Offline WebP Compressor](https://rehanquantlab.com/tools/offline-webp-compressor.html): Canvas-powered client-side image compression.
